title: Reorg, Rebase, and the 2026 Credit Bomb
script_summary:
**ORACLE BRIEF**

Foundry just erased two blocks from the chain at height 941,880 — a two-block reorg that happens once every 150,000 blocks. This wasn't accident. It was hashrate dominance. Foundry commands 30 percent of global hashrate and just demonstrated what block withholding looks like at scale. Mining consolidation is becoming the next regulatory target.
